stories.title: AI tool will lead to more child refugees being treated as adults, charity warns
stories.summary: Charities warn that the Home Office's use of an AI facial recognition tool to determine the age of child refugees may result in children being wrongly classified as adults. The concern is that algorithmic bias could expose vulnerable young people to inappropriate or unsafe conditions.

stories.title: More than 16,000 refugees unable to reunite with families in UK, says Refugee Council
stories.summary: The Refugee Council reports that over 16,000 refugees are unable to bring their families to the UK under current Home Office policy restrictions. The organisation is calling for a review of family reunion rules.

agencies.name: DEFRA
agencies.description: Department for Environment, Food & Rural Affairs

stories.title: Drought declared in half of England
stories.summary: The Environment Agency has declared a drought across half of England, with rivers running critically low. Farmers are having to harvest crops early and wildfire risk is significantly elevated across the country.

stories.title: Fisheries Act 2020: Post-Legislative Assessment published
stories.summary: DEFRA has submitted a post-legislative assessment of the Fisheries Act 2020 to Parliament, evaluating the Act's performance and impact since its introduction following Brexit.

stories.title: Furness section of King Charles III England Coast Path officially opened
stories.summary: A new stretch of the England Coast Path in Furness has been officially opened, funded by Natural England and DEFRA. The route passes through coastal communities and internationally important habitats.

stories.title: MoD data breach a 'foreseeable' failure that left Afghans in danger
stories.summary: An inquiry has found that a MoD data breach exposing the personal details of thousands of Afghans applying for UK resettlement was a 'foreseeable' failure. The MoD failed to implement adequate data protection safeguards, leaving vulnerable people at risk.

stories.title: Funding boost for British companies to supercharge UK munitions production
stories.summary: The MoD has placed contracts with 22 companies to fund feasibility studies into new sites for energetic materials factories, part of a broader push to boost domestic munitions production capacity.

stories.title: Port freight annual statistics 2025 published: imports up, exports down
stories.summary: DBT released annual port freight statistics for 2025, showing imports increased 2% to 237.5 million tonnes while exports decreased 4% to 98.6 million tonnes. The trend is consistent with patterns observed since 2000.

stories.title: Public spending statistics: July 2026 released
stories.summary: The government has published its July 2026 public spending statistics, providing comprehensive data on public expenditure arranged thematically by sector.

agencies.name: DSIT
agencies.description: Department for Science, Innovation and Technology

stories.title: NHS England publishes guidance on medical device regulation for ambient voice technology
stories.summary: NHS England has published guidance clarifying medical device regulation requirements for ambient voice technology (AVT) products, which are increasingly used in clinical settings to reduce administrative burden. The guidance helps NHS trusts and suppliers understand their regulatory obligations.

stories.title: MHRA draws regulatory line for Ambient Voice Technology in healthcare
stories.summary: The MHRA published new guidance on 29 July 2026, developed in partnership with NHS England, to clarify the regulatory framework for AI-powered ambient voice technology products used in clinical settings. The guidance sets an important precedent for how these tools will be regulated going forward.

stories.title: Royal Mail raises prices for bulk users by a third
stories.summary: Royal Mail has announced an average 25% increase in prices for bulk letter users — covering items such as marketing materials, bills, and medical appointment notices — with changes taking effect from 5 October. Some bulk users will face increases of up to a third.
